raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the core concept of the problem by conflating "using a machine for more than one purpose" with "using storage space efficiently." The shelves are an accessory added to the wall/room, not a function of the washing machine itself. The washing machine still only washes; the shelves simply utilize vertical wall space to store items, which is the definition of efficient storage. The Planner prematurely declared the task complete without distinguishing between the function of the machine and the function of the added storage structure, leading to an incorrect selection of option C over the correct option B.
